messages:
lina_sales: Quick CAIQ question — customer asks for a clear ownership table for POC (KMS, logging, model weights, inference data). Can we confirm what Redwood marks as 'customer' vs 'vendor' for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? Need for security review by EOD.
aj_eng: Short answer: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys & infra by default, Dedicated = keys managed by Redwood unless customer brings KMS (BYOE) option, Private = customer-managed. But we should call out logging retention and access. I'll draft a table.
sam_security: @aj_eng mostly right. For CAIQ we mark control ownership like: Crypto keys (C-02): Vendor for hosted (unless BYOK), Shared for dedicated (if BYOK then customer), Customer for private. Logging (A-05): Vendor for platform logs, Shared for application-level logs. Also note: we cannot provide raw GPU memory dumps for hosted.
mike_sre: FYI operational docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-ownership (internal) — For dedicated we have a config option `kms_mode: BYOKE|Redwood` in deploy manifest.
lina_sales: Can you paste the simple table I can drop into the CAIQ doc? Customer needs plain text.
aj_eng: pasted below
```
Control,KMS,Platform Logs,App Logs,Model Weights,Inference Data
Hosted,Vendor,Vendor,Customer,Vendor (no weights access),Customer
Dedicated,Vendor or Customer (BYOK opt),Vendor,Customer,Vendor (unless customer uploads),Customer
Private,Customer,Customer,Customer,Customer,Customer
```
sam_security: Add note about attestations: we can provide SOC2 report for Hosted/Dedicated; for Private, we'd provide integration guidance. Also clarify data residency: Hosted supports regionized deployments but not guaranteed per-tenant unless Dedicated/Private.
lina_sales: perfect. I'll attach to CAIQ response. One last ask — what about vulnerability scanning evidence?
mike_sre: We can provide weekly scan summaries and CVE mitigation timelines. I'll attach example report to the thread in a bit. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: deployment finished for customer-poc (env: dedicated-eu) — 1851234590
lina_sales: thanks all! I'll send to customer and flag any follow-ups.
